# seis-espiritu, the five bots (remake-bot -script, docs/BOTS.md): from DesertColossus_Adult they follow A into SpiritTemple;
# bots 3 and 4 lift A when it falls; bot5 sends the flag; bot1 goes down and bot2 lifts it.
# Letterless directives read the bots' log, 'server' the server's.
# Generated by tools/harness/seis_adulto.py: edit its tables, not this file.
#! transport ws
#! bot-arg -real -look auto
#! count joined as player \d+ >= 5
#! never script line \d+
#! never until P1 .*timed out
#! never revive: nobody down
#! count bot\d: scene \S+ -> SpiritTemple \(loading >= 5
#! expect bot1: alive -> downed
#! expect bot1: downed -> reviving: revive requested by P[2-6]
#! expect bot1: reviving -> alive: revived \(by P[2-6]\)
#! expect bot2: A held .* REVIVE sent to P[2-6]
#! count bot\d: script done >= 5
#! count server player \d+ joined: >= 6
#! never server group defeat: all
#! never server refused a connection
#! expect bot[34]: A held .* REVIVE sent to P1
#! expect bot5: flags: FLAG_SET sent \(0xdc943ffa\[0\] kind \d+ = 1\)
scene DesertColossus_Adult
age adult
follow 1 3
until 1 scene SpiritTemple 400
until 1 down 400                            # A's life 0 in its first room (mark caida)
@3-4 revive 1                               # walk to it, hold A 3.5 s
until 1 up 120                              # the game's revive takes 6 s
@3-4 follow 1 3
wait 10
@5 flag SpiritTemple_Room16_Unlocked bool 1                 # a room's result: the host's game takes it
@5 mark flag
wait 10
@1 down                                     # where it stands
@1 mark down
@2 revive any                               # walks to it, holds A 3.5 s
@1 wait 45                                  # lifted 6 s after the request (a revived bot stands)
@1-2 follow 1 3                             # after A again
wait 10
mark done
